name: Class Organizer
tech: Java, Android SDK, SQLite, Room, Material Design, Firebase, JSON

features.text: Built from scratch following Google’s latest Material Design Guideline 2018 bearing a simple yet useful design.
This open-source app converts released routine excel files for 1500+ classes per week to JSON files delivered using Github Pages and consumed in app using Retrofit.
Downloaded over 5000 times with 1000+ daily active users and 300+ five star reviews.
